turns.text: Hello. I would like to return a catalogue print. It does not suit the wall.
Hello, I can help with that. Please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with, so I can check the return for you.
The order is SC-5211 and the email is ysolde.macinca@example.com. It arrived within the last two weeks.

Thank you, Ysolde. Your return request for order SC-5211 (Păunul de ceață, 40x50 cm) is filed as R-1. It is pending, and staff must approve it before any refund is made. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage. Please keep the print in its original condition until you have the return instructions from our team.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: I will pay the return postage. Please file the return for the team to approve. I am not asking for a reprint.

Your return for order SC-5211 is already filed as R-1 and is waiting for staff approval. You don't need to file it again. You confirmed you will pay the return postage, which is the shop rule for catalogue prints. Staff will decide on the refund, and a reprint is not part of this request.
